market.question: Will Crude Oil (CL) hit (HIGH) $115 by end of June?

assessment.reasoning: WTI front-month spot ~$102 on May 1; CME settlement basis. EIA forecasts Brent peaking ~$115 in Q2 2026 (=~$108-112 WTI). With ~60 days until end-June and active Hormuz tensions, a daily settle >= $115 is plausible; recent intraday touched ~$111 but settle has lagged.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether peace negotiations remove the geopolitical premium before June expiry.
